summary.name: MeetingBar
summary.one_liner: MeetingBar is a macOS menu bar app that shows upcoming calendar meetings and lets you join or create them in one click.
use_cases: join calendar meetings from the menu bar
create a meeting in one click
open Zoom, Google Meet or Teams links quickly
see upcoming meetings without switching apps
manage meetings across multiple calendars on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: MeetingBar runs on macOS and works with your calendar to show upcoming meetings in the menu bar. It lets you join existing meetings or create new ones with a single click. The page says it supports 50+ meeting services, including Zoom, Google Meet and Teams, and works with all calendars. It can be installed with Homebrew (brew install meetingbar) and is listed as open-source on GitHub. The page also mentions powerful preferences and states that it does not store user data.
notable: Supports 50+ meeting services including Zoom, Google Meet and Teams
Installable via Homebrew or the App Store
caveats: Page says it is fully free but also offers optional support via Patreon, Buy Me a Coffee or App Store in-app purchases
